description: This file initializes an in-memory SQLite database, loads a vector extension, creates a virtual table for vector embeddings, inserts sample data, performs a cosine distance query between vectors, and outputs the results. It's a script demonstrating usage of vector operations with SQLite via the 'sqlite-vec' extension.

methods.name: vec
methods.description: Converts an array of numbers into a Buffer containing a Float32Array, suitable for database insertion as a vector.
